text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Oh man, it's no good. I can't focus one bit...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I wanna go on a reckless
shoppin' spree
'n spend a whole heap of
cash without worryin'
about the
consequences...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bet it must be real fun to fill a shoppin'
trolley up
to the brim... I'd throw fish
cakes in, and pea
sprouts, and bean
sprouts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in her wildest fantasies, Tamamo
Cross only
splurges on cheap groceries.
But from the looks
of it, she's fairly
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The non-stop races must be taking their
toll on
her. I think it's about time I
adjusted her schedule.
